title.narrative: Feasibility Study Freedom of Expression in Central America
Feasibility Study Freedom of Expression in Central America

description.narrative: Fojo Media Institute ansökte om finansiering för att genomföra "genomförbarhetsstudie om potentiellt mediestöd, i Guatemala och grannländer", under det första kvartalet 2020. Bidraget består i analys av kontexten och identifiering av relevanta aktörer för att föreslå möjliga ingångar för ett framtida stöd till medieutveckling i Centralamerika.

Fojo Media Institute applied for funding to carry out the "Feasibility Study on potential media support, Guatemala and neighbouring countries", during the first quarter of 2020. The contribution consists in the analysis of the context and the identification of relevant actors to to propose possible entry points for a future support to media development in the Central American Region.

The purpose of this project was to conduct a study to propose strategies, entry-points and approaches to strengthen free, independent, professional journalism contributing to transparency and accountability in Guatemala and possibly neighbouring countries.
